projects.title: A Python CLI application for CI/CD system
projects.bodyText:
- Lead a team of 4 member to develop a Python CLI application performing basic functions of a Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) system 
 - Developed the Yaml rules and validators for valid pipeline configurations that can be run by the system 
 - Utilized MongoDB as datastore and AWS S3 for artifact storage 
 - Developed program interact with the Docker Engine for execution of the pipeline 
 - Test run on sample Python, Java and JavaScripts repository for the standard Build, Test and Doc action

projects.title: Optiver - Trading at the Close Kaggle competition attempt
projects.bodyText:
- Used LightGBM and XGBoost as base machine learning models to prefict the relative closing price movements in the last 10 minutes for Nasdaq-listed storcks based on order book and closing auction data 
 - Performed Exploratory Data Analysis by looking at the correlation and distribution of data 
 - Established benchmark using Linear Regression Model 
 - Performed feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning using Optuna library 
 - achieve Test submission score of 5.38 (compared to leading score of 5.32)

projects.title: Series of Computer Vision Projects
projects.bodyText:
- Use C++ OpenCV libraries to build a series of application applying custom visual effects to images/videos 
 -  Project 1 allows user to apply grayscale, Gaussian filter, sobelX & sobelY effects etc to image or video. 
 - Project 2 perform Content-based Image Retrieval (Pattern Recognition) to find images in database similar to given target image. 
 - Project 3 identify a set of 2-D objects using translation, scale and rotation invariant features. 
 - Project 4 generates virtual object in a scene (Augmented Reality) similar to image shown here. 
 - Project 5 explored Convolution Neural Network (CNN) for digit recognition 
 - The final project applied Convolution Neural Network for Plant Species Identification through leaf

projects.title: Socius App
projects.bodyText:
- A social application used to practise some of the popular techstacks 
 -  Backend developed using NodeJS 
 - Database used MongoDB as persistant datastore, and Redis for in-memory caching 
 - Automated deployment using Docker, Terraform and Circle CI 
 - Utilized AWS EC2 (Public and Private instances), VPN, Load Balancer, Route 53 and Elastic Cache

projects.title: Twinder Server
projects.bodyText:
- A Scalable Distributed System Project handling API similar to a Tinder application
 -  Backend servlet developed using Java servlet and deployed on Tomcat Server on AWS EC2
 - Message Queue using RabbitMQ 
 - Database using Redis 
 - Employed CQRS pattern 
 - achieved best latency in class

projects.title: TweetQA
projects.bodyText:
- A Web App for question and answering based on tweet texts powered by BERT model
 - Front end developed using Angular 
 - Back end developed using Flask 
 - Database powered by MySQL & SQLAlchemy 
 - Deployed to Google Cloud
